title: Cargo Manifest

reward.description: A leather-bound ledger, smelling of coal and tea. Every page is stamped 'APPROVED'.

hints: An accumulator loop: total = 0, then add each crate's weight inside the loop.
For heaviest, start with best = crates[0] and replace it whenever you find a bigger one.
For load_airship, keep a running total. Before adding a crate, check whether it would go over capacity. If it would, stop the loop with break.
